note: Adams County Conservation campground on a peninsula of 650-acre Lake Icaria north of Corning, the water on three sides: gravel sites around a loop and along two rows, most with a lake view, plus tent sites and cabins at the tip. Modern restroom/shower houses, playground, fish-cleaning station, fishing docks, dump station and water at the entrance. The separate Timber Ridge Campground, about 1.2 km south-west, is the reservable one. --Claude
summary: Rescoped to Lake View alone (stored data mixed both Icaria campgrounds): 153 -> 87 sites, fees 27-35 -> 20-30, reservation fee cleared, booking reservable operator -> FCFS only, year-round added. Waterfront lead down: lakefront -> lakeview. Pin in the lake. Timber Ridge split candidate.
flags: WATERFRONT LEAD DOWN, lakefront -> lakeview. Rows: the south outer row (sites 41-61, the only row facing open water) has pad tails ~72-78 m from the shore at its west end and 100-145 m farther east, across open mown lawn with picnic tables and the fishing docks (imagery estimates, Overpass down). No road between the south row and the lake, but nothing within ~50 m. North-side sites (14-23) are 65-95 m from the north shore behind the tent area, cabins and a tree band; the east row (1-13, 62-68) is inland. The county says 'most sites having a view of the lake', which supports lakeview. Unsure -> down.

SPLIT CANDIDATE: Timber Ridge Campground (1777 Juniper Ave; Google 41.0486,-94.7447; 4.7 stars, 66 reviews) is ~1.2 km from Lake View with its own entrance off Juniper Ave, and is not in the DB. It is the reservable one: 39 full-service, 23 electric/water, 4 tent; $30 full / $27 electric-water, +$5 online convenience fee, reserve a year ahead for May 1 - Sep 30, otherwise FCFS, 3-day limit; wooded, no on-water sites seen on imagery (a single loop in forest ~100+ m from the lake). The stored fees ($27/$35, $4 reservation fee) and the 153-site count and note were Timber Ridge's or the combined park's; I rescoped this entry to Lake View.

BOOKING CONFLICT on the county's own pages: the mycountyparks park page says Lake View 'campsites #25 - #40 can be reserved online up to a year in advance', but the campground map PDF says 'No reservations are accepted for this campground', the brochure says first-come first-serve, and mycountyparks lists no Lake View site facilities (only Timber Ridge 01-…, cabins and cottages). Set FCFS always.
SITE COUNT: the park page says 24 full / 43 electric / 20 tent (= the map's numbering 1-88); the older brochure says 10 full / 57 electric / 20 tent. Used the page and map.
PIN: stored 41.05418,-94.73360 is in the lake south of the peninsula. The loop's centre is ~41.0557,-94.7340 (~170 m; Google's Lakeview Campground pin 41.05554,-94.73359). Suggest 41.0557,-94.7340.
Phone 641-322-4793 and the mycountyparks website match the county.
